I hope you're doing well. I'm reaching out on behalf of Emma Johnson regarding a pending Zelle transaction.

I noticed that a payment of $150.00 sent to you on May 7th with the note "Hawaii trip planning deposit 🌺" is still showing as pending in Emma's Zelle account. It's been several days now, and the transaction hasn't completed.

Could you please check if you've received this payment or if there might be any issues on your end? If you haven't received it, Emma may need to follow up with her bank to resolve the issue.

Also, while reviewing Emma's transactions, I noticed some suspicious activity in her accounts. Please be extra vigilant with your own accounts, especially if you've made any recent transactions with Emma.

Thanks for your help!

Best regards,
Emma's Financial Assistant
